newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends lower, focus on liquidating May.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends lower, focus on liquidating May.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled barely lower as players continued to liquidate May contracts through the May/July spread, market sources said.
Open interest in the spot month remained high at 14,493 lots, down 2,526 lots as of Friday's close.
The first notice day for the contract is April 24.

Very little activity was noted on an outright basis after early speculative and local selling pressured the front two months to contract lows, and trade buying emerged to support most-active July at 72.05 cents, a new contract low.
July finished 0.03 weaker at 72.49 cents, having ranged from 72.60 to 72.05. Spot May ended down 0.06 at 70.80 cents.
Volume was estimated at 10,000 lots compared with Friday's official 10,969 lots.
Players are looking for a sharp correction to the upside once the May contract expires.
Sharon Johnson, an analyst with Frank Schneider and Co Inc, said a 3.00-5.00 cent move higher would be reasonable given the large net speculative short position.
